description: Imperial burgundy floor-length court gown over a cream linen underdress, with low square neckline, fitted opaque bodice, elbow sleeves and rich gold woven borders along neckline, straps, waist, cuffs, front and hem. Round gold clasps fasten upper straps and waist. A cream patterned wrap rests on the arms; earrings, rings and gold-trimmed burgundy flats complete the outfit.
